en: A single average cumulus cloud contains about 1.1 million pounds of water, making it as heavy as 100 elephants.
It takes nature approximately 500 years to naturally form just one single inch of nutrient-rich topsoil.
Pumice is a volcanic rock filled with gas bubbles, making it the only natural rock that floats on water.
The water you drink today is the exact same water that dinosaurs drank millions of years ago because Earth constantly recycles it.
Venus rotates so slowly and backward that a single day on Venus is actually longer than its entire year.
Olympus Mons on Mars is a massive shield volcano that stands nearly three times taller than Mount Everest.
A neutron star is incredibly dense, meaning a single sugar-cube-sized amount of its material would weigh about a billion tons.
Because the Moon lacks wind and water erosion, the footprints left by Apollo astronauts will remain visible for millions of years.
The 1883 eruption of the Krakatoa volcano was so explosively loud that it ruptured the eardrums of sailors 40 miles away.
The Atacama Desert in Chile is so extremely dry that some weather stations there have never recorded a single drop of rain.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a massive storm so wide that planet Earth could easily fit across its diameter.
The 1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile was the most powerful ever recorded, releasing energy equivalent to thousands of atomic bombs.
